subject: POC plan & success criteria — LunarPay trial (next steps / final readout scheduling)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@lunarpay.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@lunarpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC plan & success criteria — LunarPay trial (next steps / final readout scheduling)

Hi Elena & Tom,

Thanks again for the call today — great alignment on the business case and primary evaluation goals. Per our discussion, I summarized the proposed POC scope and next steps below and attached a draft sheet with success criteria for your review. High level: Redwood will provide a 4-week trial (dedicated instance) to validate throughput/latency at your peak traffic profile and to evaluate inference quality on your reconciliation prompts.

POC scope (summary):
- Duration: 4 weeks (recommended start: Aug 2)
- Workloads: batch reconciliation jobs (50–200 req/s), and interactive API for support agents (p95 latency target 150ms)
- Success criteria (attached): throughput, latency, token-cost per reconciliation, and quality benchmark (accuracy vs your labeled set >= 92%)
- Ownership: LunarPay: Elena (PD lead), Tom (eng lead). Redwood: Marissa (AM), Marcus (SE), me (sales owner)

Immediate next steps:
1) Elena: confirm start week (Aug 2 vs Aug 9) and provide a sample of 200 labeled prompts (anonymized) by Fri 7/23.
2) Marcus: will send the evaluation plan and test harness repo + instructions.
3) Marissa: will send an updated mutual action plan and contract pointer (trial terms).

Final readout & decision: We recommend scheduling a 45–60 min exec readout in week-of Aug 30 to present results and capture a go/no-go. If positive, commercial next step is a Dedicated capacity commit; Marissa will lead contracting.

Attaching: LunarPay-POC-Success-Criteria.xlsx (draft) and Mutual-Action-Plan-Redwood-LunarPay.pdf

Thanks — happy to tweak the criteria if you want.

Best,
Rishi
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@lunarpay.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@lunarpay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC plan & success criteria — LunarPay trial (next steps / final readout scheduling)

Thanks Rishi — this looks good and close to what we discussed. A couple quick clarifications:

1) Start date: Aug 9 (team availability is tight the first week of Aug).
2) On success criteria: can we add a UX-quality check for top-3 suggestions being relevant in >90% of cases (this is a business-level metric for reconciliation suggestions).
3) We'll provide a 200-sample set of anonymized prompts by EOD Friday (7/23).

Tom and I will sync with infra next to confirm whether we can expose a staging endpoint for the interactive tests or if you should spin up your private instance. We'll confirm by 7/23.

Elena
VP Product, LunarPay
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@lunarpay.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC plan & success criteria — LunarPay trial (next steps / final readout scheduling)

Thanks Elena — adding the UX-quality metric makes sense. Quick technical notes on the evaluation plan so your infra/ML teams can prep: 

- Evaluation harness: I'll share a private GH repo with a test runner that will run both batch and online workloads against the instance. It will measure p50/p95 latency, tokens/second, and sample outputs for the quality checks.
- Data: please send the 200 anonymized prompts + a small labeled ground-truth file (CSV) with expected reconciliation labels.
- Staging vs private instance: if you can provide a staging endpoint we can avoid a private deployment; however, for accurate latency/cost numbers at scale we recommend Redwood Dedicated (we can fast-track a trial dedicated instance).
- Acceptance tests: I'll include automated checks for:
  - Throughput at target concurrency (pass/fail)
  - p95 latency < 150ms (pass/fail)
  - Quality: top-3 suggestion relevance >= 90% and labeled accuracy >= 92%

I'll drop the repo link and a short runbook by EOD Thu.

Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@lunarpay.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC plan & success criteria — LunarPay trial (next steps / final readout scheduling)

Elena — thanks for the confirmation. I've updated the mutual action plan (attached) with the Aug 9 start and included milestone owners and timelines. Quick highlights / MAP items: 

- Week 0 (Aug 2–6): prep (Redwood to provision trial infra if we do dedicated instance; LunarPay to provide anonymized prompts and access details).
- Week 1–4 (Aug 9–Sep 3): Run evaluation (see success criteria). Weekly syncs on Tue mornings (30 min) — I'll set calendar invites.
- Final readout: week of Aug 30 — propose Tue Aug 31, 11:00–11:45 PT for exec readout with Elena, Tom, LunarPay analytics lead, and Redwood leadership (Rishi + Marcus + Marissa).
- Decision gates: unanimous go from execs or list of outstanding items with remediation plan and timeline.

Contracts: I'll attach the trial terms and a pointer to the Dedicated capacity order form. For trial we can do a short MSA addendum + statement of work; legal will handle the minimal terms.

I'll send calendar invites once Elena confirms the Aug 31 slot works for you all.

Thanks,
Marissa

Thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming the key items: 

- Start date: Aug 9. Redwood to provision dedicated trial instance unless you confirm staging endpoint by 8/6.
- Deliverables due: sample prompts + ground-truth CSV by 7/23 (Elena) — if there are delays, please flag.
- Data handling: Redwood's standard trial DPA (short form) will be used; Dev (cc'd) from legal will send the short DPA confirming 30-day deletion and minimal retention.
- Weekly checkpoints: Tuesdays, starting Aug 10 (Marissa to send invites).
- Final readout: Tue Aug 31, 11:00–11:45 PT (execs + leads). Decision process: exec readout will capture pass/fail on each acceptance test; a positive readout triggers commercial next steps (Dedicated commit). If any critical gaps, we'll document remediation items and agree timeline; final commercial approval will be signoff by LunarPay execs and Redwood CRO.

Next action items (owner / due):
- Elena: confirm staging vs dedicated by 8/6; send prompts (7/23).
- Marcus: share eval harness + runbook (7/22) — sent to Elena on 7/22.
- Marissa: calendar invites + trial terms (7/23).
- Dev: send short DPA (7/30).

I'll follow up after Marissa sends invites to ensure exec attendees are included. Looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
Rishi
